ops-bot: PAGER: [billing.metric.visibility] severity=P1 region=eu-west-1 — elevated missing usage events; overage flags spiking. thread_ts=1753054322
kevin: on it — starting with emitter health + kafka lags
jane: seeing emitter-frontend returning 503s in past 2m, looks like writes failing. sample log: `EmitterError: write EPIPE`
alex: checking kafka consumer group `billing-emitter-consumer` offsets — lag high: topic=usage-events partition=5 lag=124000
sara: support note: 3 customers reported overage emails ~2m ago. dashboards show delayed ingestion / zero increments for eu-west-1
kevin: re-routing traffic to emit-backup (s3-ingest) temporarily. running: `kubectl set env deployment/emitter BACKUP_MODE=true --namespace=prod`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary rollout emitter v3.1.4 -> v3.1.5 in eu-west-1
jane: quick prometheus check: `sum(increase(usage_events_received[5m]))` -> 0 in eu-west-1 for emitter, so ingestion stalled upstream
alex: scheduling consumer reset. command: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-3:9092 --group billing-emitter-consumer --reset-offsets --to-earliest --execute --topic usage-events`
patrick: coordinating comms — recommend: "We observed delayed usage ingestion impacting billing dashboards; charges are paused while we investigate." getting approval from legal/ops
sara: confirm reprocessing path: if backlog > 1M events we should run batch backfill job v2 with throttling
kevin: mitigation plan: 1) enable BACKUP_MODE -> done, 2) scale emitter replicas + restart pods, 3) restart kafka consumer, 4) enqueue backfill (job id=bf-1753054322)
jane: emitter pods restarted, new logs show TLS handshake errors when connecting to proxy: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` — proxy cert was rotated ~18h ago, might be mismatch
alex: consumer restart in progress — lag dropping: 124k -> 20k and continuing down
kevin: backup ingest producing ~200 req/s to s3-ingest; sampled events reaching ledger (checked tx ids 0x7a1b..0x7a2f)
ops-bot: SYSTEM: overage flags suppressed by auto-suppress policy during incident (policy_id=autosuppress-4)
sara: hold customer emails. ops will prepare a cautious status update in 30m if metrics stay steady
patrick: created postmortem ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BI-9999 — adding timeline + runbook actions
jane: preliminary root-cause hypothesis: proxy cert rotation + a consumer config drift caused emitter TLS failures -> ingestion stall -> delayed counting -> shadow overage evaluation tripped flags
kevin: continuing monitoring for 10m. if stable, we'll mark mitigated and schedule full backfill overnight with throttling
ops-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated region=eu-west-1 mitigation=backup-ingest+consumer-restart monitors=ok last_message_ts=1753054520 :thumbsup:
